annotations.title: CVE vulnerability lookup: by CVE ID

description: CVE vulnerability lookup by ID (CVE-2021-44228): the description, CVSS score and severity, whether CISA lists it as exploited in the wild (KEV) and since when, the EPSS probability of exploitation in the next 30 days, the weakness (CWE), affected products with fixed versions, and patch and advisory links. Use to triage a security alert, decide what to patch first, or check an advisory before upgrading a dependency. Example: cve=CVE-2021-44228. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
